Definition: Rissah, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: The name is Rissah, a place in the Desert. You find the name in Numbers 33:21, "…they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah", and again in Numbers 33:22.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Rissah is on the map because God did his work in real places, not in nowhere. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
